The girls do not understand why they can’t have treats. 

(Basically we can’t feed pip before she goes to vet. And we can’t feed Zoë in front of Pippa, so it’s a full spectrum canine rights scandal)

Maybe because he literally just put an entirely unqualified political hatchet man in charge of the DNI — while we’re at war — and the only reason he could give was that he would look into the “stolen” election bullshit? He’s making hugely important decisions based on a lie. That seems worth paying attention to. He also tried to set up a compensation fund for people who, inspired by his promulgation of that lie, laid siege to the Capitol. Oh and the only legislation he cares about is all wrapped

“Good morning. It’s Monday. I don’t think we’re getting treats this morning. I’m worried that means someone is going to the bad place. I have a an idea for making sure it’s not me. I’m going to stay in laps. You can’t take a dog to the bad place if you can’t get up.  Also, I love you.”
“Good morning. It’s Friday. Don’t be frightened by my collar. It’s for scaring away mean dogs. At least that’s what they told me. Also, I love you.”
I forgot I’ve had an account here since 2023. Kicking the tires now.
Giving this a whirl. This is my first Bluesky post and, yes, I'm tweeting pictures of my dogs. Don't say you weren't warned.
